analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($120.67) vs SMA5($138.32)/SMA20($130.57)/SMA50($175.16) — Diagnosing short-to-mid term trend below moving averages.
· Position relative to SMA100($157.42)/SMA200($104.55) — Potential shift to a weaker long-term trend.
· 52-week position (33.3%) + Current price range approaching historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (48.3→41.9) — Failed attempt to exit oversold, continued decline.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (4.3852→2.7497) — Worsening, indicating continued bearish momentum.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (near Lower Band $99.96) — Bandwidth contraction phase.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($116.47) — Positioned above Pivot S1($87.14).
· Swing Resistance ($191.29) — Potential trend reversal if broken.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Lower High) — Interpreted as continuation of downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.79x) — Reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Downtrend) — Initiating short position, potential for further decline if 1st support level breaks.
